criteria.name: cumulative_heat_load
criteria.description: Computes 11.8 C-days above 30 C from the daily maximum-temperature series.
criteria.partial_credit: 2-3 points for the correct exceedance formula with one daily term or rounding error; 1 point for recognizing a 30 C exceedance load but summing the wrong window.

criteria.name: peak_and_non_peak_split
criteria.description: Computes peak-day share near 0.466 and non-peak heat load near 6.3 C-days.
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for one correct split metric; 1 point for identifying the 2021-06-29 peak term but using incorrect division or subtraction.

criteria.name: hot_run_length
criteria.description: Finds the 4-day run with Tmax at or above 30 C.
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for the correct dates with an off-by-one count; 1 point for applying the 30 C threshold but including a non-hot day.

criteria.name: hot_run_warm_nights
criteria.description: Computes the warm-night share within the hot run as 0.75.
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for the correct warm-night count with an incorrect denominator; 1 point for using Tmin and the 16 C threshold but applying it to the full event window.

criteria.name: wet_bulb_margin
criteria.description: Uses hourly temperature and relative humidity to compute a Stull wet-bulb maximum near 22.0 C and a 2.0 C margin to 24 C.
criteria.partial_credit: 2 points for a wet-bulb maximum within tolerance but a wrong margin sign or rounding; 1 point for using hourly temperature and humidity but not the Stull approximation.

criteria.name: diagnosis_and_explanation
criteria.description: Returns the persistence-recovery dry-heat diagnosis and ties it to the computed decomposition.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for the right label without tying it to the four rule checks, or for a correct qualitative conclusion with a slightly wrong label.

criteria.name: output_format
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON fields with sensible rounding and one concise explanatory sentence.
criteria.partial_credit: 1 point for all required values in a readable structure with minor formatting omissions or an overly long explanation.
